verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches team administration. The API has a users endpoint (/users/me), collaborations can grant access to users and groups, and an enterprise-wide event feed lets an app monitor actions by any user in the enterprise. None of these documents user provisioning or group management as such. Missing for 10: documented user/member provisioning endpoints (create, deactivate, delete users), group create/membership management endpoints, dedicated admin endpoints for enterprise settings, and independent corroboration of API-driven team administration.
